search_results.title: Community garden reopens for spring
search_results.snippet: The riverside community garden reopens this weekend.

page: The riverside community garden reopens this weekend after winter maintenance. Volunteers rebuilt the raised beds and repaired the irrigation lines. The garden committee thanked local businesses for donating soil and seedlings for the new season.
